Neutral help guide

Numbered steps

  1. This page displays the choices available for the package. Some choices include tracking, notifications, or a signature option. These notices are sent to the contact details provided so the recipient knows when the example item is on its way. Only choices available for this sample item are shown.

    • Some zones have extended handling times. Find out more here.

  2. Timing aims shown for each option are based on most addresses. However, timings may vary depending on the destination area. For options where delivery is an aim rather than a guarantee, no target time is provided for items sent to the following areas:

    • AA1-9, BB10-18, CC21-24, DD7-9, EE15-21, FF1-17, GG20-38, HH41-80, JJ10-11, KK13-14, LL17-18, MM19-44, NN49-50, PP21-25, QQ, RR, SS, TT.

    In these cases, handling may take longer and no estimated timeframe is guaranteed.

  3. Depending on the choices selected, extra cover may also be offered to provide compensation for damage or part loss. Select the cover amount closest to the value of your sample items before continuing to the next section.

  4. On this page, enter the address where you want to send the sample item. If sending within the same country, begin typing part of the address or postcode into the search field, or use the manual address link to show all fields. As a minimum, include a name or company name, the first address line, and a town or city. A postcode is also required.
  5. If sending outside the same country, include details about the contents in this section. Depending on the destination selected, these extra details may be mandatory for a declaration.
    • The declaration category is required to describe the basis on which the goods are sent.
    • The item description should be a short description of the sample item, for example books, photos, clothes, or sweets.
    • The quantity refers to the number of this type of item being sent, for example enter 2 when sending two books.
    • The item weight and item value should be the weight and value of one item. We multiply these values by the quantity to get the total weight. If sending more than one type of item in a single package, use the add-another-item button below to describe the other items.
    • If the destination requires an extra fee, the amount is calculated after the package contents are entered. This remains a long rich bullet item before a focused link. Find out more about fees.
    • If the destination requires later payment, the charges are shown in the basket and may be paid during purchase or by the recipient at delivery.

  6. On this page, enter your own details. This address is used if the item needs to be returned. Begin typing your address or postcode into the search field, or use the manual address link to show all fields.

  7. If a collection is already booked and has not been picked up yet, select the option to hand over the new item with that collection. Alternatively, arrange a new collection by selecting a suitable date and whether a label should be printed. You can also add safe-place and access notes.

  8. Click the continue button.

Basket and checkout

  1. From the basket page, which is available from the icon in the top right corner of the page:
    • Enter your email address so the confirmation can be sent.
    • Confirm you are not sending any restricted items.
    • Confirm you have understood the terms and conditions.
  2. Once the steps above are complete, choose whether to pay with a card or a wallet service. If the browser supports mobile wallet payment, you can also use that service from the same checkout page.

Single item with inline links

  1. Once payment is complete, the documents and codes required to send the sample item are available. See the Sending your item and Printing sections below for more information. A confirmation email also includes a link back to the purchase page.

Collection steps

If a collection was not scheduled when postage was obtained or a pre-printed returns label is available, arrange one using a separate collection flow. Select arrange collection from the sample service. The process then guides the user through arranging collection of up to ten items.

On this page you can tell us which items to collect. The item types fall into two categories:

  1. Items that are being sent during the current purchase.
  2. Items that were purchased previously through a similar service, or postage for an item being returned with a tracked returns label.

Here you need to say where the items should be collected from. If other items are already in the basket, the sender address used for those items is pre-selected, but another address such as a workplace can also be entered. Once the address is confirmed, choose continue.

Complete purchase

Once the basket is ready, complete the purchase:

  • Enter your email address so confirmation emails can be sent.
  • Confirm no restricted items are included.
  • Confirm the terms are understood. Choose whether to pay with a debit or credit card or by PayPal mobile payment.

Until midnight the day before collection, these choices are available:

  • Amend a booked collection
  • Choose a different collection address or different timeslot
  • Cancel the collection and get a refund

Printing

Once a label is purchased it must be printed and attached to the item. There are two ways to print it: with a personal printer, or using a free label service at a local desk.

Depending on the selected service, a QR code appears in the confirmation email after purchase. Take this code to a local service desk where it is scanned and the label is printed. Attach the label to the item and drop it off while there.
